test_title: PYST 144: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row facing South. N is exactly in between P and Q. O is to the immediate left of R. M is to the immediate right of P. If Q is at the extreme left of the row, then who is sitting to the immediate left to O?
solution: **Given :** Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row facing South. **Explanation : ** 1) N is exactly in between P and Q. 2) M is to the immediate right of P. 3) Q is at the extreme left of the row.
